question.question: 알약 하나에 얽힌 이야기입니다. 1989년 영국 샌드위치에 있던 화이자 연구소가 협심증(심장에 피가 모자라 가슴이 조이는 병)을 고치려고 한 성분을 합성했습니다. 그런데 임상시험에서 심장에는 별 효과가 없고 뜻밖의 다른 효과가 두드러졌습니다. 그래서 1998년 전혀 다른 병의 약으로 승인된 이 약은?
question.explanation: 사이먼 캠벨이 이끈 화학자들이 만든 성분으로, 첫 임상시험은 웨일스 스완지의 모리스턴 병원에서 했다. 2008년 한 해 매출이 19억 달러를 넘었다.

facts.note: Sildenafil (compound UK-92,480) was synthesized in 1989 by a group of pharmaceutical chemists led by Simon Campbell working at Pfizer's Sandwich, Kent, research facility in England. It was initially studied for use in hypertension (high blood pressure) and angina pectoris ... suggested the drug had little effect on angina, but it could induce marked penile erections. Pfizer therefore decided to market it for erectile dysfunction, rather than for angina; this decision became an often-cited example of drug repositioning. ... approved for use in erectile dysfunction by the FDA on 27 March 1998, becoming the first oral treatment approved to treat erectile dysfunction in the United States

facts.note: 처음에는 이 약을 협심증 치료제로 사용하려고 임상실험을 했으나, 그 임상실험에서 남성의 음경이 발기되도록 하는 데 탁월한 효과가 있는 것을 확인해 발기부전 치료제로 만들어졌다.

facts.claim: 1984년 9월 10일 레스터 연구실 · X선 필름 · 기술자 가족
facts.note: Jeffreys says he had a "eureka moment" in his lab in Leicester after looking at the X-ray film image of a DNA experiment on 10 September 1984, which unexpectedly showed both similarities and differences between the DNA of different members of his technician's family.
Jeffreys's DNA method was first put to use in 1985 when he was asked to help in a disputed immigration case to confirm the identity of a British boy whose family was originally from Ghana.
British geneticist Sir Alec Jeffreys independently developed a process for DNA profiling in 1984 while working in the Department of Genetics at the University of Leicester.

In 1986, Richard Buckland was exonerated, despite having admitted to the rape and murder of a teenager near Leicester ... This was the first use of DNA fingerprinting in a criminal investigation, and the first to prove a suspect's innocence. The following year Colin Pitchfork was identified as the perpetrator of the same murder
